finding.summary: Object.freeze does not freeze Map entries. The exported enforcement Map accepts set/delete, so an importer can add an arbitrary SQL digest and make assertProbeSqlAllowed accept it without changing any pinned source bytes.

repair: Keep the enforcement Map private and expose only immutable copied diagnostics needed by tests. Deep-copy or deep-freeze exported source-pin metadata. Preserve this candidate and recheck the exact finite templates and source callers in a new candidate.
